'''Prototype Droid HL-1''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Conquest of Makeb]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]], along with [[Prototype Droid TK-7]] was guarding the schematics of [[Isotope-5 droid]]s employed by the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] and was destroyed by an individual seeking to acquire those schematics for the [[Galactic Solutions Industries]]<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Prototype Droid HL-1 appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' expansion, added to the game with Update 2.0.
